facts.fact: Le Mauricien reports that Maupass is a platform that authenticates users to reach government digital services, with a login and a one-time code by SMS or email to open MoKloud.
Le Mauricien reports that Maupass logins give access to MoKloud services from several bodies, including the National Transport Authority, the Registrar, Local Authorities and the Supreme Court.

MUS.note: The document states no link between the civil register and the ID system.
The document mentions payslips for civil servants but no digital-skills training.
No count or share of people holding a national ID is stated.
Birth certificates are offered online but no ID number at birth is stated.
Nothing on who operates or owns the national ID system.
No public register keyed on the national ID number is stated.
The national ID system itself is not described; only ID card appointments are mentioned.
Local Authorities services are offered online but no office connection is stated.
